Forward-compatibility guarantees for shipped clients, per the connector-forward-compat plan.

New golden wire-compat test (`wire_compat_test.py` + vendored old-client model snapshots under `compat/`): every client-consumed endpoint's live response is validated against each in-window shipped client's strict models, every route must be classified (covered or explicitly exempt), and snapshots age out with a prune-or-extend failure -- so a response-shape change that would break the fleet fails CI before it can deploy. It already caught and fixed one live break: `is_new_account` is now excluded from the `/auth/signup` and `/auth/signin` JSON responses (no client reads it there; the strict shipped models reject any new field).

Workspace-record sync: PUTs now merge preserve-on-absent (a field absent from the push keeps its stored value; an explicit null clears it), and records carry a `record_format` column (migration 027). A push whose record_format is below the stored row's is refused with a structured 409 (`code: record_format_too_new`), so an old client can never half-rewrite record semantics it cannot see. The response omits a format-1 record_format for the pre-tolerant fleet (CLEANUP-tagged).

The web chrome and accounts bundles send the canonical `X-Imbue-Client: web/<deploy-id>` header; the web chrome additionally write-locks records written at newer formats (its only secrets-blob write creates a fresh blob at workspace creation, so a newer-format payload is never rewritten by it), shows a "new version available -- reload" nudge when its baked deploy id no longer matches `/version`, and preserves unknown record fields through its pushes (pinned by tests). Secrets blobs now carry a `payload_format` and use canonical sorted-key serialization (crypto vectors regenerated).
